correspondence: One finite current content, projection or same-page restore intent interleaved with one current read and one external writer. Separate owner readiness/Operation from local/Record finite intent. Safety plus conditional progress; no claim of distributed CAS or complete management verification.
review_basis: Reviewed the protected operation source at 6c4cee6 against 93a895f3, together with native write validation, the partial-update writer, management wrappers, registration and removal. The four modeled production guards remain unchanged: final current-read fence, projection classification, unknown never-replay action and non-content completion qualification. The new skill_action union uses content-owner semantics; only registration may seed the exact existing page before binding, and that path still requires its stable identity, applying state and original operation. Native completion now compares a complete observed body by supported structural equivalence while freezing the original input bytes; Source/resource remain exact. VerifyTarget abstracts the successful verification result and does not prove Markdown equivalence. Automatic matching resume still requires a caller to repeat the original frozen input. Registration before owner binding, preservation of unselected bodies and removal's terminal Trash/relations/Files/Resources sequence are not enumerated by this one-action model; their permanent production and fault regressions are identified below. The earlier metadata-first restore boundary for hidden Trash relations remains outside the model's single Trash bit. Only the reviewed operation source hash changes; all seven configurations, complete rule inventories and four actual guard mutations remain intact. These hashes bind inspected inputs, not a refinement proof or a substitute for actual run results.

CurrentLifecycle.bounds: One owner with two abstract content identities; one finite intent of fixed kind content/projection/restore; one non-idempotent product action with known/unknown accepted/unknown absent outcomes; at most one foreign writer; one current read; dispatch count 0..2.
CurrentLifecycle.assumptions: Metadata/body/dispatch/observation actions eventually return. Weak fairness covers operation dispatch, caller reinvocation with the original frozen input (including automatic matching resume), verification/finalization/retirement and an already-started read. Without these assumptions the model makes no eventual-success claim. Unknown absent ends in an explained blocked state with the intent retained.
CurrentLifecycle.scope: A ready owner has no content Operation while projection/restore may retain a separate finite intent. Completion qualification records the state at completion; a later writer does not retroactively invalidate a completed read. Same-page restore abstracts Trash as one bit and shares readiness guards. Bound create/update content steps use the content abstraction, but initial unbound creation/registration and terminal owner deletion are not represented: content Finish returns the owner to ready. Exact page identity, policy, budgets, physical retirement and Source parent/child cursors remain production regressions.

implementation_bindings.name: current_read_publication
implementation_bindings.scope: The final owner readiness check and consumptionFence reject a writer that started or completed during body/provider acquisition. Equality abstracts the complete production fence. This is a change detector, not a lock or cross-owner transaction.

implementation_bindings.name: finite_intent_separate_from_content_owner
implementation_bindings.scope: preserveReadyOwner distinguishes projection/restore from authoritative writes; a precise non-ready owner blocks their completion. A never-replay action with an unobservable prior result retains its intent. The model's blocked state is an explained stop, not automatic recovery.

unmodeled_bindings.scope: Native local admission and complete readback preserve supported text, code, links and structure while accepting representation normalization. Original input bytes/hash/frontmatter/mode remain frozen; current Notion body is authoritative afterward. Source/resource exact-byte verification is unchanged. The model's abstract verified bit does not establish these parser, byte, export or Notion rendering properties.

Exact target/Source-claim admission, create-only identity, automatic frozen-input recovery and unselected-file preservation are production obligations. Registration can hold an intent before binding an existing page; both scope and seed observation must preserve a later foreign operation marker. The finite model starts with a ready owner, has no ownerBound variable and does not prove that registration guard or its idempotent PATCH recovery.

Removal freezes complete owned Files/Resources and managed reverse relations before owner Trash, verifies each cleanup and uses completion=retired. Frozen exact-child readback handles hidden Trash relations without treating an empty live query as proof. Terminal owner deletion, multiple referring owners and the idempotent cleanup sequence are not represented by the content configuration's ready completion.

Physical Notion IDs and duplicate detection, current policy/input schemas and upgrades, multipart/file transfer, Source child ordering, arbitrary files/owners, remote request latency, SQLite crash/locking, permanent history, natural language and Pi/provider behavior are not enumerated.

maintenance.routing: Current lifecycle production/guard/test/model/input changes run this complete suite and its real guard mutations. The request-engine suite remains independently selectable.
maintenance.model_semantics: Review each finite bound, atomic observation and fairness assumption. Positive and intentional negative configurations use the same independent rule inventory. Hash changes require actual diff review; they do not constitute a proof.
